description.en: Specifies whether the cluster is managed by an ACK cluster.

description.zh:
是否自动续费，取值范围如下：

- **true**：自动续费。
- **false**：不自动续费。

默认为**false**。

> 当参数**PayType**取值为**Prepaid**时，该参数才生效。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

- **true**: Auto-renewal is enabled.

- **false**: Auto-renewal is disabled.

Default value: **false**.

> This parameter takes effect only when **PayType** is set to **Prepaid**.

description.zh:
是否自动使用优惠券，取值：
* true（默认）：使用优惠券。
* false：不使用优惠券。
description.en: Specifies whether to automatically use a coupon. Valid values:

The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
The description of the cluster. You can use the description to perform a fuzzy search.
The ID of the PolarDB cluster that the application depends on.
The node specification.
The extension.
The inference engine.
The Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) cluster ID.
The Kubernetes configuration.
The management mode of the Kubernetes cluster.
The type of the Kubernetes deployment.
The Kubernetes configuration.
The management mode.
The password.

description.zh:
付费类型，取值范围如下： 

- **Postpaid**：按量付费。
- **Prepaid**：预付费（包年包月）。
description.en:
The billing method. Valid values:

- **Postpaid**: pay-as-you-go.

- **Prepaid**: subscription.

description.zh:
若付费类型为**Prepaid**时，该参数为必传参数。指定预付费集群为包年或包月类型。 

- **Year**：包年。即选择包年包月时，单位为年。
- **Month**：包月。即选择包年包月时，单位为月。
description.en:
The unit of the subscription duration. This parameter is required if **PayType** is set to **Prepaid**. Valid values:

- **Year**

- **Month**

description.zh: 优惠券编号，不填时使用默认优惠券
description.en:
The coupon code. If you do not specify this parameter, the default coupon is used.

- true (default): Use a coupon.

- false: Do not use a coupon.
The region ID.
The security group ID.
The storage space. Unit: GB.
The storage type.
The billing intervals for the pay-as-you-go cluster.

description.zh: 任务开始时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）。
description.en: The start time of the billing interval. The time is in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC.

description.zh: 查询结束时间，查询结束时间需晚于开始时间，格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ`（UTC时间）。
description.en: The end time of the billing interval, which must be later than the start time. The time is in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC.

description.zh:
若付费类型为**Prepaid**时，该参数为必传参数。
- 当**Period**为**Month**时，**UsedTime**取值为整数类型，取值范围为`[1-9]`。
- 当**Period**为**Year**时，**UsedTime**取值为整数类型，取值范围为`[1-3]`。
description.en:
The subscription duration. This parameter is required if **PayType** is set to **Prepaid**.

- If **Period** is set to **Month**, the value of **UsedTime** must be an integer from `[1-9]`.

- If **Period** is set to **Year**, the value of **UsedTime** must be an integer from `[1-3]`.
The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID.
The vSwitch ID.
The availability zone ID.
